channel.title: Malformed RSS fixture
channel.description: A mix of good and deliberately broken items.

item.title: Missing Link
item.description: This item has no link and must be skipped.
This item has an empty title and must be skipped.

item.title: Unparseable Date Survives
item.pubDate: not a real date at all
item.description: publishedAt is required by nothing -- RawItem.publishedAt is optional, and interpreting a date string is normalizeItem's job, not this adapter's. This item must survive with publishedAt passed through VERBATIM as the raw (unparseable) string, not dropped and not null'd out by the adapter itself.

item.title: Good Item Two
item.description: Another perfectly normal item, positioned right after several bad ones.

item.title: Whitespace Only Link
item.description: Link is present but blank -- must be skipped same as a missing link.

item.title: Good Item Three
item.description: No pubDate at all -- still a valid item.
This item has no title element at all and must be skipped.
